comment: The ONLY fields that may leave the database for the Google Sheet mirror.
ADR 0011: the no-correlation rule extends to the mirror, so this list may
never gain a member or profile field. tests/unit/sheet-export-fields.test.ts
asserts that, and asserts the sync script selects exactly these columns.
The two tokens are deliberately absent: an unsubscribe token in a
spreadsheet is a live capability sitting in a document, and the sheet does
not need it to show who is on the list.
